rows.en: That alarm... Are we under attack!?
Damn the Vegan Empire... Are they trying to intercept us as we approach the Moon...!?
Let's go, Daisuke! No, Duke Fleed!
Right!
Me! Number one in the Commander Ranking! Beaten?!
uncertain: Source is a defeat cry with no verb ('This me, No. 1 in the Commander Ranking...!'); 'Beaten?!' supplied from the context of a defeat line. 'Commander Ranking' from glossary term [jp].

rows.en: Nuuuoooh! Me... How could I, of all people...?!
uncertain: Source is a bare 'Me... this me?!' defeat cry; 'How could I' supplies the implied disbelief.

rows.en: Rom!!
Mark my words! I shall return!
uncertain: [jp] is English in katakana; rendered as plain English.

rows.en: Lord Gades, I served you faithfully! Why won't you come to save me?!
uncertain: ガデス様 rendered 'Lord Gades'; assumed the line is addressed to Gades (rescue plea).

rows.en: Ah, no! My Commander Ranking's gonna drop!
uncertain: Kansai-dialect comic line ('[jp]'); dialect conveyed only through casual register.

rows.en: Milady! Master Rom! I am terribly sorry!
uncertain: お嬢様 = Leina (Jim is Leina's servant) -> 'Milady'; ロム様 -> 'Master Rom'.

rows.en: What has justice ever done for me? Justice does nothing for anyone...
uncertain: くれる object not stated; 'for me' / 'for anyone' chosen.

rows.en: Pass this on! Tell them I fought a battle no martial artist would be ashamed of!
uncertain: 伝えてくれ has no stated recipient; kept unnamed ('Tell them'). Likely meant for Rom, not asserted.

rows.en: Brother Rom! I'm sorry!
Wh-wh-whoa! Rooom~!
I'm counting on you to carry on!
uncertain: 後を頼む: Rom asks the listener (his allies) to take over; listener not named.

rows.en: Unable to continue combat...
They got me?! No way!!
uncertain: やられた has no subject; 'They got me' (agent unspecified).

rows.en: Ah... Aaah?!
N-no way... Is this as far as I go...?!
Y-you're kidding! Me, of all people?! I can't believe it!
Ugh! I can't be like this... I just can't let it end like this!
uncertain: [jp]: the 'I' is inferred (Asuka berating herself).

rows.en: Yes... That's how it should be......

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled from glossary ＥＶＡ量産機 = 'Mass-produced EVA'.

rows.en: I'll leave your fate be... for now!
uncertain: [jp] (retreat line): 'I'll hold off on your fate for a while'.

rows.en: Careless of me... Is this the end...?!
Damn, is this as far as I go?!
No...! It can't be, not this!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; ガルファ speaker filled as 'Gulfer' (glossary term ガルファ, do_not_touch). Probably the generic Gulfer soldier unit (ガルファ素体 = 'Gulfer Soldier'); kept the shorter in-game label.

rows.en: O-Oyakata-samaaa!
uncertain: お館様 kept as 'Oyakata-sama' per glossary term.

rows.en: Wh-what?! Impossible!!
Th-this can't... This is absurd...!!
It's no good! I have to bail out!
uncertain: 脱出しないと has no subject; 'I' inferred (Kirakuni flies the Cell Fighter; not verified that it is solo).

rows.en: We have to... bail out...!
uncertain: 脱出しなきゃ has no subject; 'We' inferred because Dendoh is co-piloted by Ginga and Hokuto. This line is reused in 3 places (s00r00:32/33/173) and may play when Hokuto is in another unit - check.

rows.en: Is this the end...?!
Nuooooooh!!
It seems retreat is my only choice...!
uncertain: [jp]: subject inferred as 'my' (Vega speaking for herself); could be 'our' if she leads a group.

rows.en: Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor... Please... forgive me...
uncertain: [jp] -> 'Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor' using glossary 'Gulfer Emperor' (note: glossary en_short for that entry is 'Galfa Emperor', inconsistent with en_full/do_not_touch 'Gulfer').

rows.en: B-bailing out~! Ryoko, don't get mad at me, okay?!
uncertain: 脱出 has no subject; rendered as 'bailing out' (Hikaru herself).

rows.en: Curses...! Hurry, all hands, evacuate!
Dammit! Is this how it ends?!
Wha! This is as far as I go?! How pathetic...!
uncertain: ここまでかよ / 情けねえ: subject 'I' inferred (Saburota about himself).

rows.en: Yu... Yurika......
In death, none shall gather my bones... To perish is my fate...
uncertain: [jp] is a stock oath phrase ('none will gather the corpse of the fallen'); rendered with 'my' since he is speaking of himself.

rows.en: Omoikane... I'm sorry. All hands, abandon ship!
This is the end... and that's a wrap...
uncertain: 一巻の終わり ('end of the scroll' = 'it's all over'); Izumi is a punster, 'that's a wrap' keeps the media idiom.

rows.en: Ngh! Next time, victory will be ours!
Uwaah! Captain, sir!!
uncertain: 大尉殿 = Meio (captain) -> 'Captain, sir'.

rows.en: Dammit, you'll pay for this! You Dragonar scum!!
uncertain: 覚えていろ rendered 'you'll pay for this' (stock threat).

rows.en: Uoooooh?!
D-dammiiiit!!
Take care of my mom for me...!!
uncertain: 頼んだぜ: Kaine asks the listener (unnamed) to look after his mother; direction kept as a request.

rows.en: C-Colonel!!
uncertain: 大佐 = Gon Jem (colonel).

rows.en: What?! Waaaah!!
It's no good! I'm bailing out!!
C-Captain, sirrr!
uncertain: 大尉殿 = Meio.

rows.en: As long as I live, the Giganos Empire shall never fall...!
uncertain: [jp] literally 'as long as I am here'; 'as long as I live' chosen.

rows.en: Heh, so this is as far as I go...
Tch, that's all for today!
uncertain: ここまで: impersonal 'that's all for today' kept (Min retreating).

rows.en: Sorry! This is as far as I go!
Am I going down...?!
Ngh, how could this...
uncertain: なんという… trails off in the source; kept the omission.

rows.en: Ah, no...!
Waaaah!! I-it's no good~
Judau! They got me!
No no no no!
Dammit! Sorry, I'm bailing out!
D-damn! They got me!
This is... the end...
N-no good! I've been hit!
Big brother...!
uncertain: Leina's brother is Judau; kept as 'Big brother' rather than naming him, matching the source.

rows.en: Aah, why did this happen to me of all people!?
uncertain: Source is the fragment 'why this me!?' (nande kono atashi ga); restored a verb ('happen to me').

rows.en: No good! I'm bailing out!
My unit's already done for!? Amuro...!
uncertain: Source 'mou kitai ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'already done for' (unit destroyed).

rows.en: So this is it... All hands, evacuate!
I... I lost...!
uncertain: Source 'maketa no ka' has no subject; restored 'I' (Argo about himself).

rows.en: Ugh! D-Domon!!
Hahaha... It's no use! You have no chance of winning...
You lot are finished no matter whaaat!
Splendid... Gwaaah!!
Ugh... ugh... I... I lost...!
uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary (speaker_jp is the short form 'Saishi').

rows.en: Ugh, guh, ah, aaaagh!
Alas... My fate, too, ends here...
Jeeesus! You gotta be kidding me!
Graaaaaah!!
Brrrrrr...
uncertain: Horse noise (Fuunsaiki); kept as 'Brrrrrr...'.

rows.en: Waaaaagh!
D-Domooon!!
You'd better remember this, you bastard!
Wh-whoa-whoaaa~
uncertain: Boss's comic exclamation 'arryaryaaan' has no fixed English; rendered as a goofy 'Wh-whoa-whoaaa~'.

rows.en: Noooo~! Koji~!
Daaamn iiit!
I'm bailing out!
Oh, come on. Whoa!?
Oh well. I'm counting on you for the rest, everyone.
uncertain: Direction: 'ato wa tanomu ze, minna' = Hayato asking everyone to handle the rest.

rows.en: Kyaaaah! Ryo! Hayato! Benkei!
rows.notes: Source nickname maps to Ryo per campaign_terms.json and https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/流竜馬; full 竜馬 remains Ryoma.
uncertain: Source says 'Ryou-kun' (nickname for Ryoma). No glossary entry for the nickname; used glossary short name 'Ryoma'. Could be 'Ryo' if the project prefers nicknames. Honorific -kun dropped.

rows.en: Don't think this means you've won!
E-Emperor Burai!
Getter's power is... Dammit!
uncertain: Kept the source's cut-off: 'Getter's power is...' (predicate omitted in JP, deliberately unfinished).

rows.en: J-Juniooor~!
uncertain: Zuril cries out 'Junior'; glossary has the unit 'Zuril Jr.'. Referent inferred to be his Zuril Jr.; kept as 'Junior' since that is what he shouts.

rows.en: King Vegaaaa!
uncertain: 'Vega Daiou-sama': honorific -sama not rendered separately; 'King' carries it.

rows.en: I am the king of the universe, King Vegaaa!
Kyaaaah! Kojiii!!
Kyaaaah!
Damn, I got careless! Me, of all people!
U-urgh... Jigajiga... Is this as far as we go...!
uncertain: 'Jigajiga' = his Vega Beast (glossary: Vega Beast Jigajiga). Restored subject 'we' (Mors + Jigajiga).

rows.en: I'm counting on you all to protect the Earth!
uncertain: Direction: Duke asking the others (kimitachi de) to protect Earth.

rows.en: Kyaaah!! Daisuke!
uncertain: Honorific -san dropped.

rows.en: Ooooh! Ugwaaaaaagh~!
I'm sorry... Miku...
Nuooooooh!!
No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Source 'masaka, Zeorymer ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'is going down' (unit-destroyed line).

rows.en: No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Same line as 363 (Masaki instead of Masato); same inferred predicate.

rows.en: Impossible...! Omzack... my "Lightning"!
uncertain: Glossary unit is 'Omzack of the Lightning' (character entry for Saiga says 'Thunder'); used 'Lightning' to match the unit name.

rows.en: Tau... I'm sorry... I... you...!
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Aen' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Aen'; glossary only has the full form). Kept source omission 'watashi wa... anata wo...!' (no verb); the intended verb is not settled out of context. 'Tau' used bare as in source; glossary full name Shi-Tau.

rows.en: Big sister...
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Tau' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Tau').

rows.en: Y-Yuratei...
...I was careless... I... have lost...
Saiga... I... end here...
uncertain: Source 'watashi wa... koko de...' omits the verb; inferred 'end here' (dying/defeat).

rows.en: Damn... A lifelong disgrace for Kyoshiro Yuzuki!
Damn!! It's no good!
Ugh! I've been hit!?
Kyaaaah!!
Not yet! Raideen! Whoa!
This... can't be...!
Damn, it's no good!!
Waaaaaah!!
Eek!! No...!! It can't be!!
Ah! Is this the end!?
Kyaaah!!
Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Waaaaaah!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary.

rows.en: Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Uwaaagh!
uncertain: JP raw line lacks the closing bracket; translated the body only.

rows.en: 1. Destroy all enemies.
rows.notes: Player; victory objective; no dialogue referent. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: 1. Grendizer is shot down
Just one Medifo... Could it be on a scouting mission?
rows.notes: Root canonical name pass: Medifo follows Akurasu MX Mech List and main/name_fixes; initial draft unchanged.

rows.en: No, I can't tell. It could be some kind of trap.
rows.notes: Akira cannot determine the lone Midifo's intent; restored singular speaker subject instead of assuming the whole team's knowledge.

rows.en: Duke Fleed!
rows.notes: Vocative; also used in victory event.

rows.en: We don't know what the enemy will do, so we can only wait and see. Leave this to me.
rows.notes: Duke asks the others to leave this encounter to him; restored subject and asking direction.

rows.en: But...
rows.notes: Retained unfinished objection.
uncertain: Retained source fragment explicitly reviewed by worker3: Retained unfinished objection.

rows.en: Nothing can match the Spazer's maneuverability in space. So I want everyone else to stand by.
rows.notes: Duke asks everyone else to stand by because of Spazer mobility, not to join him.

rows.en: There is no need to worry, Koji. He has put his doubts behind him.
rows.notes: Kyral credits the end of Duke's doubts, not immunity from danger.

rows.en: Kyral... Did you give him some advice?
No, no... I merely put in a few words.
I believe the young lady over there is the one who guided him.
rows.notes: Young lady refers to Hikaru Makiba; later response confirms.

rows.en: No... I didn't do anything like...
rows.notes: Retained unfinished modest denial.
uncertain: Retained source fragment explicitly reviewed by worker3: Retained unfinished modest denial.

rows.en: You did it, Hikaru.
Tch... They're as lovey-dovey as ever.
Daisuke...
rows.notes: Vocative.

rows.en: Anyway, if Duke's doubts are gone, we've got nothing to worry about.
Now we just have to see what that Medifo will do...
rows.notes: Root canonical name pass: Medifo follows Akurasu MX Mech List and main/name_fixes; initial draft unchanged.

rows.en: Grendizer... Then Duke must be aboard...
rows.notes: Retained trailing realization; restored Duke as onboard subject.
uncertain: Retained source fragment explicitly reviewed by worker3: Retained trailing realization; restored Duke as onboard subject.

rows.en: Vegan Empire! What have you come here to do with just one craft!?
Ah... It really is you...
rows.notes: Restored recognition predicate; speaker confirms Duke from his voice.

rows.en: Depending on your answer, I will open fire!
Please wait, Duke! It's me!
What!? You're... It can't be...!
rows.notes: Retained interrupted recognition.
uncertain: Retained source fragment explicitly reviewed by worker3: Retained interrupted recognition.

rows.en: Yes, it's Rubina. Rubina, Princess of Planet Vega.
rows.notes: Rubina names herself with full source royal/location description.

rows.en: Rubina...! Is it really you!?
Yes. I came here alone from Skull Moon Base to see you.
rows.notes: Explicit alone retained.

rows.en: What's Duke talking to the enemy about?
We can't hear what they're saying over the comms from here.
rows.notes: Others cannot hear the exchange, which establishes their limited knowledge.

rows.en: Duke, I haven't come here to fight.
I have something important to tell you. Please follow me.
She's turned her back to me... All right, if you trust me that much, I'll follow you.
rows.notes: Duke interprets Rubina exposing her back as trust; no invented tactical motive.

rows.en: Where are you going, Duke Fleed!?
Who's aboard that Medifo!?
rows.notes: Root canonical name pass: Medifo follows Akurasu MX Mech List and main/name_fixes; initial draft unchanged.

rows.en: ...It's Rubina... Rubina is aboard that craft.
What! Princess Rubina of Planet Vega!?
If she's the princess of Planet Vega, then she's King Vega's daughter!
So you're planning to capture this Rubina, right?
...I'm sorry...
rows.notes: Apology, subject restored.

rows.en: Hey! Don't tell me you're...!?
rows.notes: Retained unfinished suspicion; no invented betrayal assertion.
uncertain: Retained source fragment explicitly reviewed by worker3: Retained unfinished suspicion; no invented betrayal assertion.

rows.notes: Deliberate silence.

rows.en: If there's a reason, tell us! Don't keep it to yourself and worry alone!
rows.notes: Reason question/request restored; asks Duke to share with the others.

rows.en: Daisuke!
rows.notes: Vocative reused during support and victory events.

rows.en: Just what is this Rubina to you, anyway!?
...If war hadn't broken out between us and Planet Vega, Rubina and I would have...
rows.notes: Unfinished source boundary retained despite glossary former-fiancee profile. Retained unfinished counterfactual outcome; intended engagement established by later229/230 but not asserted here.
uncertain: Retained source fragment explicitly reviewed by worker3: Unfinished source boundary retained despite glossary former-fiancee profile. Retained unfinished counterfactual outcome; intended engagement established by later229/230 but not asserted here.

rows.notes: Source punctuation-only shock preserved.

rows.en: I want to trust Rubina...
Brother!
Anyway, this is our chance. If we capture the princess of Planet Vega, we'll learn exactly where the enemy base is.
That's not all! If we take her hostage, King Vega might even give up on Earth!
Stop it!
Hikaru...
rows.notes: Vocative; also sympathy after fiancee revelation.

rows.en: Daisuke... Duke Fleed trusts her...
rows.notes: She refers to Rubina, identity established by200/201; Hikaru means Makiba.

rows.en: Then let's put our trust in Duke...
...I'm with Hikaru. Let's wait here for him.
If that's what you all say...
rows.notes: Retained unfinished conditional assent.
uncertain: Retained source fragment explicitly reviewed by worker3: Retained unfinished conditional assent.

rows.en: ...Are you sure, Hikaru?
Yes... If that's what Daisuke has chosen...
rows.notes: Retained conditional acceptance without completing the source thought.
uncertain: Retained source fragment explicitly reviewed by worker3: Retained conditional acceptance without completing the source thought.

rows.en: Duke Fleed... We're putting our faith in you... So... I'm counting on you...
rows.notes: Koji asks Duke to honor their trust; I'm counting on you preserves direction.

rows.en: Duke...
rows.notes: Vocative.

rows.en: Duke... Oh, Duke...! I've wanted so much to see you...!
Wait! What proof do you have that you're really Rubina?
...Do you remember? When I was on Planet Fleed, you took me out in a boat...
rows.notes: Boat memory verifies identity; no imported romance narration.

rows.en: Back then, you said I was like a red flower... as beautiful as a flower...
I remember...
Back then, Father intended for me to marry you...
rows.notes: Father intends a marriage; do not assert it occurred.

rows.en: And I thought you had accepted that, even though you never said so.
rows.notes: Rubina's belief in silent acceptance, not certain factual acceptance.

rows.en: ...But the Duke Fleed you once knew is already dead.
rows.notes: Metaphorical death of former self; Duke is speaking alive.

rows.en: What...?
The Duke Fleed standing here now is your enemy.
rows.notes: Duke declares changed opposing allegiance, not physical location.

rows.en: No, Duke. I don't think so. To think of you as an enemy...
rows.notes: Retained unfinished denial about considering Duke an enemy.
uncertain: Retained source fragment explicitly reviewed by worker3: Retained unfinished denial about considering Duke an enemy.

rows.en: But my father and mother were killed by the Vegan Empire...!
rows.notes: Both father and mother explicitly retained.

rows.en: ...When you say that, I don't know what I can do... All I can do is apologize.
Not only that, Planet Fleed was contaminated by Vegatron radiation and turned into a dead planet.
rows.notes: Radiation contamination rendered dead planet, not exploded/destroyed physical body.

rows.en: No, Duke... Fortunately, Planet Fleed hasn't been completely destroyed.
rows.notes: Denial of complete destruction, distinct from gradual recovery explained240..243.

rows.en: What did you say!?
On my way to Earth, I saw it with my own eyes. Here are the photographs.
The eerie glow of Vegatron radiation that covered Planet Fleed really is gone...
The Vegatron radiation is weakening, and Planet Fleed is coming back to life.
Planet Fleed is coming back to life...
Duke, let's stop fighting and return to Planet Fleed together!
If this war goes on, not only the Vegan Empire, but everything on Earth will be destroyed by the fighting...
The only way to make my father... King Vega stop fighting is for us to join forces.
But...
rows.notes: Deliberate hesitation; no invented objection. Retained source omission/fragment: hesitation.

rows.en: Rebellions have already broken out on several planets under the Vegan Empire's control...
The Vegan Empire will collapse before long. That's why I don't want any more pointless fighting.
Please. For peace throughout the universe, let's go to Planet Fleed together!
Rubina... that's...
rows.notes: Deliberate unfinished response, kept unfinished. Retained source omission/fragment: unfinished response.
Punctuation-only reaction retained.

rows.en: Duke Fleed, prepare yourself!
rows.notes: Hidden attacker remains ??? until source reveal.

rows.en: Who are you!?
Chief Zuril!
rows.notes: Explicit choukan retained as Chief. Retained source omission/fragment: vocative.

rows.en: Duke Fleed! I'll take your life right here!
Damn, it was a trap!
rows.notes: Duke mistakenly interprets this as a trap.

rows.en: No, Duke! I didn't know Chief Zuril had come here either!
rows.notes: Explicit choukan retained as Chief; Rubina denies prior knowledge.

rows.en: Ghh... How dare you betray me! I was a fool to trust you!
rows.notes: Duke falsely believes Rubina betrayed him; this is his accusation, not narrative truth.

rows.en: No! That's not true! Duke, I'll save you now!
Please step aside, Princess Rubina!
Ghh...!
rows.notes: Retained source omission/fragment: pain interjection.

rows.en: Die, Duke Fleed!
Look out!
Aaaaaaaaah!!
Rubina!
rows.notes: Retained source omission/fragment: vocative.

rows.en: I-impossible! She used her own body as a shield to protect Duke Fleed!
rows.notes: Zuril reacts to Rubina physically shielding Duke.

rows.en: Zuril... you...!
rows.notes: Retained source omission/fragment: unfinished threat.

rows.en: I-I... I've shot King Vega's daughter... I...!
rows.notes: Zuril admits shooting Rubina. Retained source omission/fragment: broken shock.

rows.en: Duke Fleed! It's your fault... your fault!
rows.notes: Zuril falsely assigns blame to Duke.

rows.en: Thank goodness, Duke... You're safe...
Don't speak, Rubina. Your wound will open...!
Duke... The Vegan Empire's Skull Moon Base is on the far side of the moon... at Point 0314...
rows.notes: Coordinate zeroes preserved: Point 0314.

rows.en: Why are you telling me that...
rows.notes: Restored subject and verb while preserving trailing question.

rows.en: I wanted you to believe me...
I do believe you...! That's why I'm here with you, isn't it!
rows.notes: Explicit belief statement retained, despite prior mistaken accusation.

rows.en: Yes... Thank you...
Hold on, Rubina!
rows.notes: Retained source omission/fragment: imperative with English understood you.

rows.en: Duke... I have a request... When Planet Fleed turns green again, the first red flower to bloom...
rows.notes: Request begins here and continues in 278; flower unnamed in this row. Retained source omission/fragment: unfinished request spanning boundary to 278.

rows.en: Please name it Rubina...
rows.notes: Completes previous row: Rubina asks Duke to name the flower Rubina.

rows.en: The red flower...
rows.notes: Echo fragment refers to the flower, not an omitted grammatical subject. Retained source omission/fragment: echo fragment.

rows.en: Yes, that will be me... I'll bloom every spring without fail and come back to you.
rows.notes: Flower image is symbolic promise after mortal injury, not resurrection.

rows.en: No! You mustn't die! Let's return to Planet Fleed together! We'll go back together!
rows.notes: Retained source omission/fragment: imperatives with English understood you.

rows.en: Duke... I won't die... Like a red flower... forever... by... your... side...
rows.notes: Dying symbolic promise; fading speech retained. Retained source omission/fragment: fading dying speech.

rows.en: Rubina! Rubina!
rows.notes: Retained source omission/fragment: vocatives.

rows.en: Uoooooooooh! Rubinaaaaa!
rows.notes: Retained source omission/fragment: cry and vocative.

rows.en: ...They're taking a while.
Maybe those two are really hitting it off in there.
rows.notes: Teasing insinuation rather than a statement about actual activity.

rows.en: Hey! Be a little more considerate when you speak!
S-sorry.
rows.notes: Retained source omission/fragment: apology interjection.

rows.en: It's all right... She is his former fiancee, after all...
rows.notes: Rubina is the former fiancee; Hikaru accepts the reunion.

rows.en: Still, I'm worried. He could at least call us.
Motherburn!? When did it get here!
rows.notes: Retained source omission/fragment: surprised unit name and exclamation.

rows.en: It seems that giant saucer was using a special shield to camouflage its presence!
SHIT! Are they trying to get away!?
rows.notes: Source SHIT retained without softening; plural escape referent left as they.
uncertain: Source omits escape subject; Motherburn departure establishes vessel/crew. Neutral plural they avoids guessing a named pilot.

rows.en: What about Duke! Where's Daisuke!?
Duke Fleed! Are you all right!?
Brother! What happened to Princess Rubina!?
Rubina is... dead.
What...!
rows.notes: Interjection reused after battle; no scene-specific addition. Retained source omission/fragment: surprise interjection.

rows.en: Rubina died shielding me from Zuril...
I'll never forgive them... The demons of space, the Vegan Empire!
Duke Fleed!
rows.notes: Vocative; dropped honorific per brief. Retained source omission/fragment: vocative.

rows.en: Is he... going to take on the Vegan Empire all by himself!
That's crazy! Even in Grendizer, he'd be going to his death!
His heart is consumed by rage and hatred right now... He'll destroy himself like that!
We can't just stand here! We're going after Grendizer too!
You're back, Zuril! And Rubina...
rows.notes: Deliberately unfinished inquiry. Retained source omission/fragment: unfinished inquiry.

rows.en: Forgive me, King Vega! Princess Rubina... Princess Rubina has passed away!
W-what!? Rubina is dead, you say!
F-forgive me! It's all Duke Fleed's fault!
rows.notes: Zuril repeats false blame, concealing that he shot Rubina.

rows.en: Oh... Rubina... Why did you die!
rows.notes: Retained source omission/fragment: grief exclamation.

rows.en: Even if I rebuild the Kingdom of Vega on Earth, you won't be there to inherit my throne...
rows.notes: Conditional future reconstruction on Earth; no claim Earth is conquered.

rows.en: Rubina... Why... Why did you die and leave your father all alone!
King Vega! A unit is rapidly approaching Skull Moon Base!
Th-this is!
rows.notes: Recognition trails into Vega identifying Grendizer. Retained source omission/fragment: unfinished recognition.

rows.en: Grendizer! Duke Fleed!
rows.notes: Retained source omission/fragment: recognition names.

rows.en: Damn him...! How did he sniff out Skull Moon Base!
King Vega! Please give me a chance to avenge Princess Rubina!
...Very well, Zuril. Defeat him, and I'll forgive your failure to bring Rubina back...
rows.notes: Permission conditional on defeating Duke; previous failed retrieval retained.

rows.en: But unless you kill Duke Fleed, don't think you can ever show your face before me alive!
rows.notes: Death threat retained: Zuril must kill Duke or not return alive.

rows.en: Y-yes!
I won't forgive you... I'll never forgive you, Vegan Empire!
Duke Fleed! I'll make you bitterly regret coming to the Moon all alone!
Shut up, Zuril! I'll defeat King Vega... even if I have to die taking him with me!
That's why I've fought alongside Grendizer right up to today!
rows.notes: Source says up to today; no invented years-long duration. Duke explains his lifelong resolve without quantifying years.

rows.en: Do it, Chief Zuril! Make this Moon Duke Fleed's graveyard!
Yes, sir!
Rubina... Planet Fleed's rebirth... You risked your life to tell me about it...
rows.notes: Retained intentional source fragment: Planet Fleed's rebirth is the thought topic; Rubina is addressed mentally.
uncertain: Retained source omission: the noun topic 'Planet Fleed's rebirth...' has no matrix predicate; intentional reflective fragment, not accidental pro-drop.

rows.en: Sadly, I may never get to see it with my own eyes...
But I can't help fighting in my rage... To defeat those devils... the Vegan Empire...!
rows.notes: Retained purpose fragment after complete subject and verb; rage-driven fighting is not softened. The infinitive purpose clause has its verb and object and attaches to the preceding complete matrix clause; ellipses indicate emotion, not an omitted constituent.

rows.en: I-is this where I'll meet my end... on a planet in this backwater of space...?!
Chief Zuril! You'll pay for all the people who suffered because of the weapons you developed!
H-how bitter...!
Only Commander Gandal remains... and King Vega!
Nuooh! Damn you, Grendizer! Damn you, #部隊名!
Give it up, Commander Gandal! The Vegan Empire falls today!
I-I won't let that happen...! King Vega, I'm counting on you to... Aagh!
rows.notes: Gandal asks King Vega to carry on; unfinished request is interrupted by death cry. Request direction retained.
uncertain: Retained source omission: Gandal's request 'I'm counting on you to...' is interrupted before its infinitive verb; King Vega is the listener being asked to carry on.

rows.en: Only Chief Zuril remains... and King Vega!
King Vega, prepare yourself!
I-I am... I am King Vega, king of the universe! Aaaaaagh!
Duke Fleed! Princess Rubina died because of you!
rows.notes: Zuril makes a false accusation; not narration of actual cause. Zuril shot Rubina in event 4.

rows.en: You're right... It's as good as if I'd killed Rubina myself...
rows.notes: Subjective guilt: as good as killed, not admission that Duke was the shooter.

rows.en: That's why I swore to Rubina that I would bring peace back to this universe, without fail!
rows.notes: Promise made to Rubina concerns future restoration of universal peace.

rows.en: Koji Kabuto! Come to think of it, you've thwarted our plans time and time again!
Of course! I never tolerate evil... That's Koji Kabuto's creed!
You bastards hid this ridiculously huge base all this time! I'll smash it in one fell swoop!
I won't allow it! As long as Skull Moon Base stands, the Vegan Empire is immortal!
Daisuke... I won't think about what happened between you and Princess Rubina right now...
rows.notes: Hikaru addresses Daisuke mentally; relationship questions explicitly deferred for now.

rows.en: As a warrior protecting Earth, I'll fight alongside you too!
So you're Duke Fleed's sister! I'll deal with you after him!
Don't be ridiculous! As long as I'm here, I'll never let you kill my brother!
Grendizer! At last, the time has come for us to face each other directly! Fight me!
Commander Gandal! I won't lose... I'll defeat you and drag King Vega out, without fail!
Insolent fool! I'll show you the power of Guragura, the mightiest Vega Beast!
I, Commander Gandal, will take on anyone who defies the Vegan Empire!
Heh... Once the commander himself has to come to the front, the Vegan Empire's limits are clear!
I'll show you the power of Guragura, the mightiest Vega Beast!
Heh... Guragura or Furafura, wobbly or woozy, I don't care! Beat me before you call yourself the strongest!
rows.notes: Guragura is correct source-short name. Furafura is deliberate misnaming; wobbly/woozy carries the dismissive Japanese sound pun. Added gloss makes the joke intelligible; no second canonical unit invented.
uncertain: Wordplay adaptation: wobbly/woozy gloss conveys the Japanese Guragura/Furafura mockery; licensed English joke wording unverified.

rows.en: So you're the commander! If I defeat you, the Vegan Empire will collapse completely!
You little brat, getting so full of yourself! I'll make you regret challenging Guragura!
Maria Fleed! I'll kill you and Duke Fleed and wipe out the entire Fleed royal family!
rows.notes: Source-short Maria Fleed retained, not expanded to Grace Maria Fleed. Entire Fleed royal family extermination threat preserved.

rows.en: I won't let you! The Vegan Empire is the one that will perish here!
I'll never forgive you, Duke Fleed! You killed Rubina, and I'll bury you with my own hands!
rows.notes: King Vega falsely claims Duke killed Rubina. Preserve accusation and hands-on killing threat.

rows.en: ...I won't make excuses. But don't forget, King Vega!
That the Vegan Empire has inflicted tragedies just as painful as your loss of Rubina, over and over again!
rows.notes: Retained dependent That-clause continuing forget in row 363. Intentional row-boundary fragment, not grammatical pro-drop; explicit Vegan Empire subject and inflicting verb retained.
uncertain: Retained source omission: dependent 'That...' clause continues 'don't forget' in row 363; intentional matching row-boundary fragment, not a standalone sentence.

rows.en: Grr... Grrr...!
King Vega, devil of the universe! I'll slay you right here!
So you're Koji Kabuto! If it weren't for you, I could have defeated Duke Fleed easily!
Like hell! Duke Fleed is my friend!
And you who disturb the universe's peace are enemies I must defeat too!
King Vega, prepare yourself! Now I'll avenge everyone on Planet Fleed!
Damn you, Maria Fleed! I'll kill you and your brother when you come for me!
rows.notes: Returning lethal attack to attacker rendered explicitly: you and your brother when you come for me.

rows.en: As a member of the Fleed royal family and a warrior protecting Earth, I won't lose to the likes of you!
I've heard Planet Vega has vanished from the universe too! So why are you trying to repeat this tragedy?!
Silence! If I can't have Earth, then it might as well be destroyed!
How many planets have you destroyed with that selfish way of thinking?!
King Vega! I'll never let a devil like you defile that beautiful Earth!
Earthling! I, King Vega, commend you for driving me this far! But Earth will be mine!
Like hell it will! I won't let a villain like you lay a single finger on Earth!
I've fought plenty of evil bosses, but I've never met anyone such a sore loser as you!
Silence! I am the ruler of the universe! Until the day I die, I won't let the likes of you have your way!
rows.notes: Speaker King Vega vows resistance until his own death.

rows.en: Dad and Goro live on Earth... along with so many other people...
rows.notes: Dad belongs to Hikaru; Goro is source-short, main glossary full Goro Makiba; no forced full-name expansion.

rows.en: I'll protect it, no matter what! That beautiful Earth!
Little Earth girl! Before your very eyes, I'll turn Earth, where your family lives, into a dead planet!
rows.notes: Literal dead-planet threat with family, Earth and eyewitness cruelty retained.

rows.en: Earth is my second home... I won't let it suffer the same fate as Planet Fleed!
Fwahahaha! They will all perish! Planet Fleed, Planet Vega, and Earth too!
King Vega! I will never forgive you for defiling the beauty of planets to satisfy your own desires!
Keep babbling, Earthling! Every planet should belong to me, the ruler of the universe!
rows.notes: Universal ruler claim and ownership of all planets retained.

rows.en: Then my fist will hammer it into you... Justice, the truth of this universe!
King Vega! Do you understand... the beauty of that Earth?!
Such radiance is rare in all the universe... That's precisely why it was a planet worthy of my ownership!
rows.notes: Past-tense worthy planet retained alongside rare radiance rationale.

rows.en: You don't understand anything! A planet belongs to no one... It belongs to everyone who lives there!
rows.notes: Retained source rhetoric paradox: belongs to no one, then belongs to everyone living there.

rows.en: I'll never let a devil like you defile that beautiful Earth!
So you've come, #部隊名!
You idiot! Duke Fleed!
rows.notes: Vocative abuse of Duke; no omitted declarative subject.

rows.en: Koji...
rows.notes: Vocative Koji, intentional short trailing name.

rows.en: You idiot, Brother!
rows.notes: Brother addressed directly; explicit insult, not narration.

rows.en: Cut it out, Duke Fleed!
Duke Fleed! Wake up!
rows.notes: Wake up is an appeal to reason, not literal waking from sleep.

rows.en: Maria... everyone...
rows.notes: Vocative Maria and everyone; intentional trailing fragment.

rows.en: You keep doing whatever the hell you want! Are you planning to die out there alone?!

rows.notes: Identity declaration interrupted by enemy arrival; unfinished sentence retained.

rows.en: I know what you're thinking! That's cold... Is that how you treat a friend?!
If we die, we die together... We promised we'd fight for peace, didn't we?!
Koji's right! Your anger is our anger... This battle should be everyone's battle!
Please don't forget! You're not fighting alone!
You're not some lone avenger! You're a warrior who loves peace, just like us!
Everyone...
rows.notes: Vocative; retained source omission.

rows.en: Remember, Daisuke. You're not fighting just so you can die!
You told me, didn't you?! About what you'd do after the fighting was over!
That's right, Brother! If you die... I'll... I'll...
rows.notes: Unfinished source clause continuing at row410; retained omission.
uncertain: Retained source omission: unfinished conditional and stammered I... continuing in row410.

rows.en: I'll be all alone again!
Hikaru... Maria...
rows.notes: Vocatives; retained source omission.

rows.en: Let's fight together, Duke Fleed! You're my... You're our friend!
We're comrades who joined hands to protect that beautiful blue Earth, aren't we?!
I'm sorry, everyone... I'd forgotten what matters again...
I'm the prince of Planet Fleed... But now, I'm Duke Fleed of #部隊名!
That's right! You're not alone!
You have comrades who'll fight alongside you!
You have friends praying for your safety!
Everyone, lend me your strength! King Vega is over there!
Of course! As long as he's after Earth and disrupting peace in the universe, we can't let him get away with it!
Here I come, Vegan Empire! My father's and mother's... Everyone on Planet Fleed's... And Mors and Rubina's...
rows.notes: Unfinished possessive object continuing at422; all named people retained; retained omission. Semantic review: Clarify each possessive attachment without moving the hopes object from422.
uncertain: Retained source omission: unfinished possessive object for father, mother, Planet Fleed people, Mors and Rubina; row422 supplies hopes and fighting clause.

rows.en: I'll fight with the hopes of everyone who longs for peace!
For every person on Earth and in the universe... For just one single flower!
rows.notes: Single flower symbolizes Rubina and her dying red-flower request; source here does not repeat red.

rows.en: Damn you... Duke Fleed! Listening to his words makes my skin crawl!
Gandal, you will sortie too! Bring me his head!
Yes, sir!
Look, Tetsuya! Just like we thought, that fake Great showed up!
Tch... It pisses me off, but it looks like painting 'Original' on it wasn't a waste...!
rows.notes: Painted identifying label Original, as in BEFORE gag and campaign scoped term.

rows.en: Here I come, Duke Fleed! On my pride and resolve as a commander, I'll crush you all!
Everyone! Our targets are Chief Zuril and Commander Gandal!
We'll defeat them and drag King Vega out!
Got it! I'm gonna cut loose!
1. Shoot down Chief Zuril and Commander Gandal
rows.notes: Fixed single-line objective; both ranked targets retained.

rows.en: Bah! Zuril and Gandal are both utterly useless!
If that's how it is, I shall take the field myself!
You've finally come out, King Vega!
We've beaten all your henchmen! Give it up!
Silence! The Vegan Empire will never perish as long as I stand!
I'll defeat you here and make Earth... and then the universe mine!
Villains' sour grapes always sound the same, no matter when you hear them.
Yes. The petty ones bark the loudest when they're cornered.
What did you say?!
So you're King Vega! You destroyed Planet Fleed and so many other worlds with treacherous attacks! You're unfit to be a king!
And you think you can rule the universe?! Save that nonsense for your dreams!
Damn you... Damn you, you little brats!
By now, revolts are probably breaking out on the planets the Vegan Empire conquered...
And once we defeat you, all those planets will be free!
G... Grrr...
rows.notes: Interjection; retained source omission.

rows.en: Here I come, King Vega! For peace in the universe, we'll crush the Vegan Empire here!
Try it if you can! I, King Vega, won't go down without a fight!
1. Shoot down King of Vega
rows.notes: King of Vega is the unit; reused at both506 and523.

rows.en: Grr... Damn you, #部隊名! To think you had such power...!
Whoa! Even if you apologize now, we won't let you off the hook!
We can't forgive all the crimes you've committed!
Damn you...! I am King Vega, ruler of the universe! I refuse to die so easily!
Is that bastard trying to run away, even now?!
No...! Look at his course... He's heading for Earth!
What do you mean?!
King Vega! Don't tell me you plan to crash that giant battleship into Earth!
Duke Fleed! I won't die for nothing! I'll rain radioactive fallout on the Earth you love!
rows.notes: Semantic review: Ongoing love in the death threat; no softening.

rows.en: If that huge mass of Vegatron radiation falls to Earth...
rows.notes: Conditional protasis unfinished in source; consequence remains solely462; retained omission.
uncertain: Retained source omission: unfinished conditional protasis; row462 supplies its consequence.

rows.en: Earth will suffer the same fate as Planet Fleed!
I won't let you! The greenery of Earth that my master sacrificed his own life trying to protect...
rows.notes: Unfinished object referring to Earth greenery;464 completes; retained omission.
uncertain: Retained source omission: unfinished Earth-greenery object clause; row464 completes the refusal to let Vega pollute it.

rows.en: I won't let a lowlife like you pollute it!!
King Vega alone is our target! We must settle this before that battleship leaves the Moon!
Ha ha ha! Stop me if you can!
1. King of Vega reaches the map edge@2. Grendizer is shot down
rows.notes: Fixed two-line alternate defeat conditions, not inevitable events.

rows.en: No! We can't catch King Vega!
rows.notes: Conditional map-edge failure branch.

rows.en: Gwahahahaha! Duke Fleed! I'll make you watch as the Earth you love is destroyed!
rows.notes: Conditional map-edge failure branch.

rows.en: Brother, you finally did it!
rows.notes: Vegan Empire battle victory; broader Earth campaign not declared complete. Semantic review: Restore source singular addressee rather than collective we.

rows.en: I defeated him... I defeated the devil...
rows.notes: Semantic review: Restore Duke as singular subject in his own stunned realization.

rows.en: Father, Mother... Mors... The Vegan Empire has fallen...
Rubina... Now the peace you wished for will return to the universe...
Thank you, everyone... Thanks to all of you, I was able to see this day...
Don't mention it. We're friends! We don't need to be so formal with each other!
Thank you, Koji... Meeting you helped me find my courage again.
Duke Fleed...
rows.notes: Vocative; retained source omission.

rows.en: And there's something I need to tell all of you...
D-Daisuke...
rows.notes: Stammered vocative in AFTER; retained source omission.

rows.en: Big brother... Is that really true?!
rows.notes: Maria directly addresses her brother Duke, reacting to his news; no unidentified gender.

rows.en: Yes, Rubina told me. Our homeworld, Planet Fleed, is recovering from its radioactive contamination.
rows.notes: Recovering from radioactive contamination, not completely restored.

rows.en: Then we... We can go back to Planet Fleed!
Now that King Vega has fallen, the remnants of the Vegan Empire everywhere should eventually perish as well.
rows.notes: Future expectation for scattered remnants, not a claim that every surviving unit is already defeated.

rows.en: Planet Fleed has been liberated. Our homeworld lives again!
rows.notes: Exultant lives again reflects liberation and renewed life; surrounding recovering statements do not assert completed reconstruction.

rows.en: Daisuke... I am so happy for you... So very happy...
rows.notes: Hikaru rejoices for Daisuke; explicit I restored.

rows.en: The homeworld you thought was destroyed has come back to life... I cannot imagine anything making you happier.
rows.notes: Akira refers to Duke/Maria's homeworld, not his own.

rows.en: Yeah... I am even moved by Planet Fleed's vitality, recovering in spite of the radiation.
rows.notes: Domon's emotional response explicitly I; vitality and defiance of radiation retained.

rows.en: And once they hear that Planet Fleed is recovering, the people of Planet Fleed who escaped may come back, too.
rows.notes: Return remains may, not certainty. Fleedians escaped destruction, not new settlers. Meaning/terminology correction authorized by root: replace unestablished invented demonym Fleedians with descriptive people of Planet Fleed, preserving escaped qualifier and may.

rows.en: So, Daisuke... When are you leaving for Planet Fleed?
rows.notes: Koji asks Duke when he leaves, not Koji's own departure.

rows.en: I do not know yet...
rows.notes: Duke subject I restored.

rows.en: You are not planning to return to your homeworld now that it has come back to life?
rows.notes: Tetsuya questions Duke's hesitation, not deciding for him.

rows.en: That is not it. As a member of Fleed's royal family, I...
rows.notes: Genuine unfinished I clause at royal-family self-description; following row493 corrects his framing.
uncertain: Retained genuine source clause/modifier/list fragment at matching row boundary.

rows.en: No, as one of the few surviving people of Planet Fleed, I intend to devote all my strength to rebuilding Planet Fleed.
rows.notes: Self-correction retains few survivors, commitment, and rebuilding. No renunciation of royal lineage invented. Meaning/terminology correction authorized by root: replace invented Fleedians while preserving few, surviving, full commitment, and reconstruction.

rows.en: But before that, there is something I must do as an Earthling, Daisuke Umon.
rows.notes: Explicit full Earth identity Daisuke Umon, with Earthling role, preserved.

rows.en: Maria... Would you mind if our return to Planet Fleed were delayed just a little?
rows.notes: Duke asks Maria to accept slight postponement, not permanent abandonment of Fleed.

rows.en: Of course not! Earth is my second home, too!
rows.notes: Maria accepts delay; Earth her second home too.

rows.en: Planet Fleed can wait for peace to return to Earth, too.
rows.notes: Fleed can wait personification preserved.

rows.en: And the day we return home should not be too far away...
Yes. The day peace returns to Earth... That will be the start of a new chapter in Planet Fleed's history, too.
rows.notes: Future return of Earth's peace begins a new era for Fleed, not achieved peace now.

rows.en: Are you sure about this, Daisuke?
rows.notes: Domon checks Duke's decision.

rows.en: Yes. Thanks to Earth and all of you, I was able to find a light beyond my anger and hatred...
rows.notes: Earth AND comrades are thanked; light beyond anger/hatred echoes before-scene Kyral counsel.

rows.en: As long as that light shines, I will fight without hesitation...
rows.notes: Independent vow I will fight stays explicit.

rows.en: As Duke Fleed, and as Daisuke Umon, for my two beloved homes.
rows.notes: Genuine modifier continuation of502, retained at row boundary rather than duplicating its predicate.
uncertain: Retained genuine source clause/modifier/list fragment at matching row boundary.

rows.en: That is a fine smile, Daisuke Umon. Even I can see it clearly.
rows.notes: Kyral is physically blind; even I can see metaphorically echoes his before-scene insight. Do not restore literal sight.

rows.en: You are welcome here. You will always be one of us.
rows.notes: Tetsuya welcomes continued comradeship.

rows.en: Yes. Once again, I am counting on all of you.
rows.notes: Request direction: Duke asks comrades for continued support; I am counting on all of you, not Count on me.

rows.en: Are you okay with that, Hikaru... even if Daisuke leaves...?
rows.notes: Sayaka asks Hikaru about Daisuke's eventual departure despite immediate postponement.

rows.en: Yes... It is what Daisuke has decided...
rows.notes: Hikaru accepts his decision, not claiming she has no feelings.

rows.en: Besides, even if Daisuke returns to Planet Fleed, it does not mean we are saying goodbye forever...
rows.notes: Departure is not permanent goodbye; they may meet again, no unsupported arrangements added.

rows.en: Why not just go with him to Planet Fleed, Hikaru?
rows.notes: Jun suggests Hikaru accompany Daisuke.

rows.en: I am all for it! A romance across the stars! How romantic~!
rows.notes: Allenby supports the romance across planets, no marriage already agreed.

rows.en: When that time comes, we would love to help you.
rows.notes: Rain offers collective support to Hikaru, not soliciting help from her.

rows.en: Thank you so much...!
It would be an interplanetary marriage, not an international one, just like Kazuya and Erika.
rows.notes: Playful interplanetary/international marriage comparison Kazuya and Erika; not a confirmed new wedding. Restore copula and conditional would for playful marriage suggestion, avoiding noun-only rendering and any claim that marriage is already confirmed.

rows.en: Speaking of which, I wonder if Nadesico C is safe... It was heading for Mars.
rows.notes: Nadesico C is heading for Mars, safety is uncertain.

rows.en: Mars is not the only thing I am worried about. The final battle with Giganos, and the fighting on Earth, too...
rows.notes: Unfinished appended list of additional worries; retain Giganos final battle and ongoing Earth fighting.
uncertain: Retained genuine source clause/modifier/list fragment at matching row boundary.

rows.en: Knowing them, we have nothing to worry about.
rows.notes: Tetsuya trusts absent comrades, without choosing unknown genders.

rows.en: All right... Let us give it our all so Daisuke and Maria can return to Planet Fleed as soon as possible.
rows.notes: Koji urges group effort to expedite both Duke and Maria's return; us/we request direction.

rows.en: When that day comes, I will invite you to Planet Fleed, too, Koji.
rows.notes: Maria invites Koji too, not announcing marriage.

rows.en: All right, Maria! I would be happy to go with you!
rows.notes: Koji accepts Maria's invitation eagerly.

rows.en: Koji!
rows.notes: Jealous vocative Sayaka -> Koji.

rows.en: W-what is it, Sayaka...? I am telling you, it is all for space development...
rows.notes: Koji's defensive space-development excuse; stutter retained.

rows.en: Hmph...! You are making eyes at Maria!
rows.notes: Nose-stretch idiom rendered making eyes at Maria, jealous accusation.

rows.en: Uh... That is... Well...
rows.notes: Genuinely unfinished that is hesitation clause, no explanation supplied.
uncertain: Retained genuine source clause/modifier/list fragment at matching row boundary.

rows.en: If you want, Koji, you can stay on Planet Fleed forever, you know.
rows.notes: Maria offers indefinite stay if Koji wants, not actual relocation agreed.

rows.en: Huh, really?! ...Oh, Sayaka, do you want to come along, too?
rows.notes: Koji turns to Sayaka belatedly with invitation, not retracting Maria's.

rows.en: Oh... I do not care anymore!
rows.notes: Sayaka's sulky dismissal, not literal ignorance.

rows.en: Ah, geez... Sayaka will never get a moment's peace with him acting like that.
rows.notes: Chibodee comments on Sayaka's lack of peace due to Koji.

rows.en: Well, in his case, he seems more reluctant to part with Daisuke than with Maria.
rows.notes: George jokes Koji would find parting with Daisuke harder than Maria; attachment comparison retained without added romantic/sexual claim.

rows.en: Father, Mother... The Vegan Empire has fallen, and Planet Fleed is coming back to life...
rows.notes: Thought to deceased birth parents, not adopted father Genzo Umon. Empire's fall coexists with483 eventual defeat of remnants; Fleed coming back to life.

rows.en: But please wait a little longer. I will fight alongside Grendizer for Earth, my second home.
rows.notes: Requests birth parents wait a little longer while he fights for second home Earth.

rows.en: And once peace returns, I will devote myself to rebuilding Planet Fleed and to peace throughout the universe.
rows.notes: Vow after future peace returns; rebuilding Planet Fleed and peace throughout universe both retained.

rows.en: Surely that day cannot be far away...
rows.notes: Hopeful future prediction, not peace already accomplished.
